title: Making of "The Prodigy - Smack My Bitch Up" in Ableton by Jim Pavloff
summary: Jim Pavloff rebuilds the Prodigy track Smack My Bitch Up in Ableton, identifying the samples used and recreating the track by hand.
why: Recommended as a fun, in-depth look at how sampling and music production work, and as proof that skilled humans can reconstruct tracks from scratch.

quote.text: I'm amazed at the level of musical knowledge needed to do this.
